有了缥缈宗的那些炮灰，这下一些想要找麻烦的也歇了这个念头，时笙住的地方，方圆几里都看不到一个活人。

等各大门派的人差不多到齐了，宗门大比也即将开始。

叶清秋带着人在大比开始的头一天才到，屁股还没坐热，第一批弟子就来告状了。

“宗主，商殊把我们伤成这样，不能就这么算了，您要为弟子们报仇啊！”

“是啊宗主，她这么做就是打缥缈宗的脸，宗主，您一定要为我们报仇！”

义愤填膺的弟子围着叶清秋，七嘴八舌的说着。

总结来，还是只有一句话，给他们报仇。

叶清秋上任宗主是不久前的事，上任宗主死后，缥缈宗宗主的位置一直空悬，有能力争的都特么躺着了，而其他人就算有实力，却因为名不正言不顺，不能走马上任。

宗门大比即将开始，他们自然不能连宗主都没有，于是还活着的几位峰主突然就联名要叶清秋上任。

叶清秋半推半就，欲拒还迎的答应了。

没了宗主那个外挂，这些年叶清秋也吃了不少苦，整个人看上去都阴沉沉的，“这事，我会为你们做主的，都先下去养伤，宗门大比不能输。”

安抚好那些弟子，将他们送走后，叶清秋一巴掌拍在桌子上，满脸的狰狞，从牙缝里狠狠的挤出两个字，“商殊！”

这个女人，杀了她师父，一把火就毁了缥缈宗。

她这几年的苦，都是拜她所赐，这个仇，她总会讨回来的。

“女娃娃，你就这般沉不住气？”讽刺的声音凭空在屋子中响起。

叶清秋一愣，狰狞之色慢慢的褪去，恢复了高冷女神范儿，“你这次又想要什么？”

“桀桀……”那声音怪笑两声，“我闻到了很好闻的味道。”

“哼。”叶清秋眼底闪过一丝嫌恶，“这是宗门大比，全修真界的势力都汇聚在这里。”

“女娃娃，这可由不得你，如果……桀桀……那后果你应该不想在试试。”

“你……”叶清秋也不知道想到什么，脸色煞白，身形微微发抖，眼底满是怨毒，垂着身侧的手紧攥成拳，青筋凸显。

宗门大比其实就是各个门派派人上去，进行切磋，以此来检验各派的实力。说白了就是摸底，看看这些年，哪家是不是又多了牛逼的打手。

With the cannon fodder of the Piaomiao Sect, some people who wanted to cause trouble now gave up the idea. Where Shi Sheng lived, there was not a single living person for miles around.

When everyone from each sect has almost arrived, the sect competition is about to begin.

Ye Qingqiu and his men arrived on the first day of the competition, and before their buttocks were even hot, the first batch of disciples came to complain.

"Sect Master, Shang Shu hurt us like this, we can't just let it go. You have to avenge your disciples!"

"Yes, Sect Master, she is slapping the Piaomiao Sect in the face by doing this. Sect Master, you must avenge us!"

The indignant disciples surrounded Ye Qingqiu and talked a lot.

To sum up, there is still only one sentence: avenge them.

Ye Qingqiu took office as the sect leader not long ago. After the death of the previous sect leader, the position of the leader of the Piaomiao Sect has been vacant. Those who have the ability to fight for it are lying there, while others, even if they have the strength, cannot take up the post because of their unfair reputation.

The sect competition was about to begin, and naturally they couldn't afford to be without a sect leader, so the few peak leaders who were still alive suddenly jointly asked Ye Qingqiu to take over.

Ye Qingqiu half-assumed, half-heartedly agreeing.

Without the sect master's plug-in, Ye Qingqiu has suffered a lot in these years, and his whole person looks gloomy. "I will make the decision for you in this matter. You all go down to recover first. We cannot lose the sect competition."

After comforting the disciples and sending them away, Ye Qingqiu slapped his hand on the table, with a ferocious expression on his face, and squeezed out two words from between his teeth, "Shang Shu!"

This woman killed her master and destroyed the Piaomiao Sect with a burst of fire.

The suffering she has suffered in the past few years is all thanks to her. She will always get back this revenge.

"Girl, are you so impatient?" A sarcastic voice sounded in the room out of thin air.

Ye Qingqiu was stunned for a moment, his ferocious look slowly faded away, and he returned to his cold goddess style, "What do you want this time?"

"Jie Jie..." The voice laughed strangely twice, "I smell a very good smell."

"Hmph." A trace of disgust flashed in Ye Qingqiu's eyes, "This is a sect competition, and all the forces in the cultivation world are gathered here."

"Girl, it's not up to you. If... Jie Jie... then you don't want to try the consequences."

"You..." Ye Qingqiu didn't know what he was thinking of. His face turned pale, his figure was trembling slightly, his eyes were full of resentment, and his hands hanging by his sides were clenched into fists, with veins prominent.

The sect competition actually means that each sect sends people to compete and compete to test the strength of each sect.To put it bluntly, it is to find out whether any company has gained more powerful thugs in recent years.
